verdict.summary: The extraction preserves the cron-expansion and derived-map behavior while moving their single ownership into scripts/cron_map.py. All three consumers are repointed consistently, their sparse-checkout inputs are updated, the new module is enrolled in the suite, and the watchdog retains its own error adapter and window-counting logic. The new self-test independently covers expansion boundaries, malformed inputs, YAML parsing, multi-cron union, missing/unparseable trees, live-tree anti-vacuity, suite enrollment, and the refusing entry point. I found no diff-supported correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect.
